description: Which window RP2-v3 results may be published under. The repository states two, and the choice between them is a research decision, not a code change.

twelve_month.note: The end is exclusive, so the last trading session inside this window is the last one before 2026-07-21. Adopting it discards roughly 309 of the 389 development sessions every existing artifact was built on, and every frozen RP2 result would be superseded rather than corrected. `last_session` is the final trading session inside the window and is not known until Block 1 has been re-run against it; publication refuses until it is recorded, so the window cannot be shortened by a run that simply stopped early.

partition.note: The window every RP2 and RP2-v3 artifact was actually built on: D 2024-08-02 to 2026-03-23 (389 sessions), V 2026-03-24 to 2026-07-17 (80), so the exclusive end is the day after the last session. Adopting this amends a rule AGENTS.md calls binding, which the rule itself says requires a recorded configuration change.
